ZAMA ZAMAS THROWFORWARD – SCRIPT

V/O Wednesday, 19 July…. A massive explosion rips through downtown Johannesburg…
V/O … While the cause is eventually established as methane gas from an unknown source, it raises serious questions about the state of Joburg’s underground infrastructure…

…and the impact of over 50 000 people digging into the city’s foundations…
UPSOUND They’re in here!
V/O They’re known as Zama Zamas – illegal artisanal miners…
UPSOUND It is destroying infrastructure, roads, water, electricity, sewage
V/O In an upcoming episode of Carte Blanche, we take you into the dark corners of a parallel world, rarely seen…
This tunnel leads to Hillbrow, that side…
V/O A subterranean maze of sewers, utility pipelines and disused mine shafts and tunnels, overrun with brazen diggers in search of the reef’s last remaining gold.
UPSOUND UPS KOBUS: 4 grams, 5.

UPS LOURENSA: What is this worth?

UPS KOBUS: This will be about, in total value, about R10k plus.


V/O It’s a disturbing industry, lucrative enough to draw big guns, ruthless criminals and the desperate…
V/O fearlessly defending their territories…


V/O A low-scale war, raging in the shadows of our City of Gold.
